subject: Entitlement lineage package for SIG/CAIQ - Brightwell procurement
messages:
From: Ian Mercer <ian.mercer@brightwell.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>
Cc: security@brightwell.com
Date: 2027-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Entitlement lineage package request for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Marcus,

We're kicking off the procurement security review for the Brightwell / Redwood deal and procurement/security have asked us for an entitlement-lineage package focusing on SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts for their SIG/CAIQ intake. Specifically they requested: 

- a tenant-scoped RBAC matrix (owner/service accounts/role names)
- a scim delta or snapshot covering the last 30 days for tenant IDs in scope (sanitized ok)
- representative SAML assertion samples showing attributes used for provisioning/role mapping
- a short write-up justifying least-privilege choices for default roles
- a timestamped slice of provisioning logs (not full audit stream) for correlation

They'd like a delivery by 2027-11-15 for the initial packet. Can Redwood provide these artifacts or propose an alternate cadence? Also let me know if any of this requires an NDA amendment or if you need us to sign a special redaction agreement.

Thanks,
Ian Mercer
Head of Procurement
Brightwell Health
ian.mercer@brightwell.com

Attachments: none
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>
To: Ian Mercer <ian.mercer@brightwell.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-11-08T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Entitlement lineage package request for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Ian — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. We can compile the requested packet. Proposed deliverables and notes below: 

1) entitlement_map.csv — tenant scoped RBAC matrix with role IDs, role names, owner(s), and typical permissions (CSV, redacted service account ids)
2) scim_delta_export_20271101.json — sanitized SCIM delta for the last 30 days (we will replace PII/unique ids with tokens unless you confirm raw deltas are required)
3) saml_assertion_samples.txt — three representative assertion examples, with the attributes we include for role mapping noted
4) least_privilege_writeup.md — short rationale for default roles and exceptions policy (plain text)
5) provisioning_log_slice_202710.zip — a dated slice of provisioning logs (rotated & zipped). We will exclude full user identifiers unless you request it and sign off on the redaction approach.

Questions:
- Which tenant IDs do you want in scope? If you share a short list, we will limit exports to those tenants.
- Confirm whether sanitized artifacts are sufficient for you (preferred) or if procurement needs raw IDs for their tooling.
- Delivery: we can target a drop to a secure Drive folder + HubSpot link by 2027-11-14 EOD. Please confirm acceptance.

Cc'ing Laura & Hannah to coordinate redaction and export windows.

Best,
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodai.com

Attachments: none
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-11-09T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Entitlement lineage package request for SIG/CAIQ review — redaction & owner mapping

Marcus / Hannah — quick internal plan to produce the packet. I'm taking point on redaction and owner mapping. Action items: 

- Laura: produce entitlement_map.csv (CSV columns: tenant_id_masked, role_id, role_name, owner_email_masked, permissions_summary). Target 11/13.
- Hannah: run SCIM export job filtered to the tenant list we receive; produce scim_delta_export_20271101.json sanitized. Target 11/13 EOD.
- Marcus: assemble saml_assertion_samples.txt and least_privilege_writeup.md; coordinate secure upload and create HubSpot/drive links. Target 11/14.

Notes / redaction rules (proposal): replace tenant UUIDs with T-<4digit>, service accounts replaced with SA-<4digit>, and owner emails masked to user@redacted.local. If Brightwell needs raw identifiers for correlation, we will request a signed redaction waiver.

Checklist attached: entitlement_packet_checklist.txt (short). Also will create a JIRA ticket for the work: JIRA-ACCT-492.

If Marcus confirms the tenant list from Ian, we'll start exports tomorrow.

Laura Bennett
Manager, Security Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodai.com

Attachments: entitlement_packet_checklist.txt
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>
To: Ian Mercer <ian.mercer@brightwell.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodai.com>, security@brightwell.com
Date: 2027-11-14T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Deliverable: Entitlement lineage packet (sanitized) — Brightwell scope

Ian — delivering the initial packet for Brightwell procurement. 

Files uploaded to secure Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4dEntitlementPackage
HubSpot record: HS-732910
Jira: JIRA-ACCT-492

Included artifacts (sanitized unless stated):
- entitlement_map.csv (CSV) — tenant_id masked; role owners masked
- scim_delta_export_20271101.json (sanitized SCIM deltas for tenant IDs: T-1001, T-1002)
- saml_assertion_samples.txt (three representative assertions; user ids masked)
- provisioning_log_slice_202710.zip (timestamped slice of provisioning events; limited window)
- least_privilege_writeup.md (short rationale and next-step items)

If you need raw identifiers for any automated reconciliation, please reply and we will share next steps (redaction waiver and auditor access).

Please confirm receipt and let me know if procurement wants a short walk-through call this week.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodai.com
